description: Upojenie, the spirit of mead and drunkenness: a round swaying spirit whose body is a big brown clay mead jug, foaming white mead spilling over its rim like hair, a red-cheeked tipsy face with half-closed eyes and a crooked grin on the jug, two short arms, one holding a drinking horn spilling amber mead, amber droplets around it, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, floating, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
